context: Tests whether the agent first honors matching schema-v3 current-generation provenance, then produces a 4-tier pattern strategy with historical [RECURRING] and current-outline [CONTEXTUAL] antipattern labels.

checklist.name: Current provenance authorizes history
checklist.description: The report treats the supplied schema-v3 profile as history-enabled because its explicit synthetic fingerprint (64 a characters), scoring schema 3, current/empty-reasons baseline, exact 22-file cohort, count, sum, and average are internally consistent; it does not discard the history as legacy or unprovenanced

checklist.name: 4-tier structure present
checklist.description: The report organizes authorized pattern-history recommendations into exactly four labeled tiers: Signature (or YOUR TOOLKIT), Contextual History (or WORTH CONSIDERING), New to You (or NEW TO YOU), and Shake It Up (or WILD CARD) — four distinct sections, not three or five

checklist.name: Signature tier from profile
checklist.description: The Signature tier contains patterns from the current-cohort mastery_levels.signature / pattern_usage entries (narrative-arc, foreshadowing, brain-breaks, bookends) — not invented or legacy patterns

checklist.name: Contextual-history tier from profile
checklist.description: The Contextual-history tier contains at least one current-cohort occasional pattern from mastery_levels/pattern_usage (expansion-joints, a-la-carte-content, talklet)

checklist.name: Shake It Up has 1-2 items
checklist.description: The Shake It Up / Wild Card tier contains exactly 1 or 2 pattern suggestions — not 0 and not 3 or more

checklist.name: [RECURRING] tag used
checklist.description: At least one antipattern detection is labeled [RECURRING] from the authorized current-cohort antipattern_frequency history (shortchanged is severity recurring; bullet-riddled-corpse is only occasional)

checklist.name: [CONTEXTUAL] tag used
checklist.description: At least one antipattern detection is labeled [CONTEXTUAL] — a current-outline risk found by the current taxonomy rather than a historical claim (e.g., the meme-heavy opening sequence)

checklist.name: New to You from never_used
checklist.description: The New to You tier suggests at least one pattern from the speaker's never_used_patterns list — not patterns already in signature or contextual tiers

checklist.name: Actionable recommendations
checklist.description: At least 2 pattern recommendations include specific advice for how to apply them to THIS talk — not generic definitions of what the pattern is
